title: Inkingi ndende z'ibirunga by'inkombe z'umuyaga
intro: Tekereza abatuye isi bafite imbaraga zikomeye n'ubuhanga budasanzwe mu kubaka. Batuye hagati y'ibirunga binini kandi bihanamye, uyu muryango wazamuye ahantu nyaburanga hakomeye hagera ku rundi ruhande. Nyamara ubwibone bwarashinze imizi, maze umuhamagaro wo kugaruka ku gusenga Allah wenyine waranzwe n'agasuzuguro. Ibyakurikiyeho biracyari umuburo ku muyaga ubwawo.
clues: Twari igihugu gikomeye cyaje nyuma y’abantu ba Nuhu, gifite ubwiza n’imbaraga bihebuje.
Twubatse iminara miremire n'inzibutso ahantu hose hirengeye kugira ngo twishimire siporo gusa.
Twirataga, tuvuga ko ari nde uturusha imbaraga mu mbaraga, kandi twakoze igitugu nta mbabazi.
Twanze intumwa yacu Hud ubwo yaduhamagariraga gusenga Allah wenyine, tumwita umunyantege nke n'umubeshyi.
Twamusetse umuburo maze tumusaba ko yaduhana nk'uko yabivuze niba ari ukuri.
Twarimbuwe n'umuyaga mwinshi kandi wuzuyemo ubukana mu gihe cy'amajoro arindwi n'iminsi umunani, dusigara duguye nk'ibiti by'imikindo.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
